aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable comparison evidence but misgroups the changed factor and includes an invalid measurement outcome.
issues: Primary factor should be repair/remove-bond semi-sub reuse vs normal, not Line L/R as changed conditions.
Line L and Line R appear to be subgroups and must be preserved as grouping keys.
Measurement outcome from header/defect columns is not a valid separate measurement analysis.
Referenced result rows Test!15 and Test!19 are not shown in context for verification.
Decision row Test!26 is relevant but not cited.
correctionPlan: Set baseline to Normal and changed condition to repaired/remove-bond VP/coil semi-sub reuse.
Move Line L and Line R into subgroup keys or subresults, not changedCondition.
Keep one function-defect outcome with Input, OK, NG categories, Total NG, and NG rate.
Remove the bogus measurement outcome and header-derived stats.
Add citations for Test!15, Test!19, and Test!26 with row text available.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Evidence is partly sufficient, but final use needs visible test-row citations and no header-only measurement stats.
